newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bridgestone agrees to buy South Africa tire firm.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone agrees to buy South Africa tire firm.

text.p: Major Japanese tire maker Bridgestone Corp said on Wednesday that it has finalised with Murray & Roberts Engineering Holdings Ltd (M&R) of South Africa to buy M&R's tire subsidiary Fedstone (PTY) Ltd for 290 million rand.
The deal was first announced last October by M&R.

Fedstone owns several tire related businesses, such as Firestone South Africa (Pty) Ltd, one of the largest tire manufacturers in South Africa, and Natyre (PTY) Ltd, which operates 50 tire retail shops, Bridgestone said in a statement.
Fedstone's name will be changed to Bridgestone/Firestone South Africa after the merger, the company said.
Fedstone's Firestone South Africa was originally set up by Firestone Tire and Rubber Co of the United States. The American company was taken over by Bridgestone in 1988, it said.
